capabilities: closes all main-area tabs except the active one across split panes
keeps pinned tabs open via a setting (on by default)
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in "Close others in tab group" (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+W) only closes tabs in the current tab group.
problem: Obsidian's built-in "Close others in tab group" only closes tabs in the focused tab group, leaving tabs open in other split panes.
summary: Single-command plugin that closes every open tab in the main area except the active one, across all split panes.
